name: Corn Futures Term Structure: Contango vs Backwardation
description: Analyzes the Corn (ZC) futures term structure by comparing calendar spreads across specific contract months. Computes old crop / new crop spread (Dec-Jul), post-harvest carry (Mar-Dec), and front-to-new-crop spread using both current-year (2026/27) and year-ago (2025/26) contracts. Includes 20-day MAs, 52-week ranges, and year-ago comparisons to contextualize contango/backwardation conditions.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN FUTURES TERM STRUCTURE: CONTANGO VS BACKWARDATION
# =============================================================================
# Analyzes ZC (Corn) calendar spreads using specific contract months:
#   Current curve:  ZCN26 (Jul 2026), ZCZ26 (Dec 2026), ZCH27 (Mar 2027)
#   Year-ago curve: ZCN25 (Jul 2025), ZCZ25 (Dec 2025), ZCH26 (Mar 2026)
#
# Key spreads:
#   jul_dec_spread  = ZCZ26 - ZCN26  (old crop / new crop)
#   dec_mar_spread  = ZCH27 - ZCZ26  (post-harvest carry)
#   front_new_crop  = ZCZ26 - front  (full front-to-new-crop)
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table of current levels and 52-week range
#   2. Old Crop / New Crop spread with 20d MA and year-ago comparison
#   3. Front-to-New-Crop spread with year-ago comparison
#   4. All three current spreads overlaid
#   5. Front Month vs New Crop price levels
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary Asset: Continuous Front Month ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zc_front = cont.c

# --- Reference Contracts: Current Curve (2026/2027) ---
ref_n26 = reference_futures(ticker='ZCN26')()
zcn26 = ref_n26.c

ref_z26 = reference_futures(ticker='ZCZ26')()
zcz26 = ref_z26.c

ref_h27 = reference_futures(ticker='ZCH27')()
zch27 = ref_h27.c

# --- Reference Contracts: Year-Ago Curve (2025/2026) ---
ref_n25 = reference_futures(ticker='ZCN25')()
zcn25 = ref_n25.c

ref_z25 = reference_futures(ticker='ZCZ25')()
zcz25 = ref_z25.c

ref_h26 = reference_futures(ticker='ZCH26')()
zch26 = ref_h26.c

# --- Calendar Spreads: Current Curve ---
# Old crop / new crop: positive = contango, negative = backwardation
jul_dec_spread = zcz26 - zcn26
# Post-harvest carry
dec_mar_spread = zch27 - zcz26
# Full front-to-new-crop spread
front_new_crop = zcz26 - zc_front

# --- Calendar Spreads: Year-Ago Curve ---
ya_jul_dec = zcz25 - zcn25
ya_dec_mar = zch26 - zcz25
ya_front_new = zcz25 - (zc_front >> 252)

# --- Change in Spread vs Year Ago ---
jul_dec_change = jul_dec_spread - (jul_dec_spread >> 252)

# --- 20-Day Moving Averages ---
jul_dec_ma = ma(period=20)(jul_dec_spread)
front_new_ma = ma(period=20)(front_new_crop)

# --- 52-Week Range for Jul/Dec Spread ---
jd_52hi = max(period=252)(jul_dec_spread)
jd_52lo = min(period=252)(jul_dec_spread)

# --- Timestamp for X-axis ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Current Levels & 52-Week Range
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn Term Structure Snapshot',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Prices', 'Spreads', '52-Wk Range'],
        col_headers=['Metric 1', 'Metric 2', 'Metric 3'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Front', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZCN26 (Jul)', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZCZ26 (Dec)', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Jul/Dec Spread', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Front/NewCrop', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Dec/Mar Spread', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='JD 52-Wk Hi', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='JD 52-Wk Lo', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZCH27 (Mar)', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(zc_front, zcn26, zcz26, jul_dec_spread, front_new_crop, dec_mar_spread, jd_52hi, jd_52lo, zch27)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Old Crop / New Crop Spread (Jul/Dec) — Headline Chart
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Old Crop / New Crop Spread (Dec - Jul): Contango vs Backwardation',
    category='2. Old Crop / New Crop Spread',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZCZ26-ZCN26', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZCZ25-ZCN25 (yr ago)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, jul_dec_spread, jul_dec_ma, ya_jul_dec)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Front-to-New-Crop Spread
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Front-to-New-Crop Spread: Full Curve Slope',
    category='3. Front-to-New-Crop Spread',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZCZ26 - Front', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZCZ25 - Front (yr ago)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, front_new_crop, front_new_ma, ya_front_new)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: All Current Spreads Together
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn Term Structure: All Spreads',
    category='4. All Spreads',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Jul/Dec (ZCZ26-ZCN26)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Dec/Mar (ZCH27-ZCZ26)', color=Color.Teal),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Front/NewCrop (ZCZ26-Front)', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, jul_dec_spread, dec_mar_spread, front_new_crop)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Front Month vs New Crop Price Levels
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Front Month vs New Crop (Dec 2026) Price Levels',
    category='5. Price Levels',
    y_axis_label='Price (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC Front Month', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZCZ26 (Dec 2026)', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, zc_front, zcz26)
